units.source_text: 男人很清楚女人想表示诚意。

en.t: The man knew very well that the woman was trying to show her sincerity.

units.source_text: 从女人那客气的、怯生生的声音调子里，到处都能感觉到，

en.t: It could be felt everywhere in the polite, timid tone of the woman's voice

units.source_text: 她小心翼翼，生怕破坏了他的情绪。

en.t: that she was being extremely careful, afraid of spoiling his mood.

units.source_text: 然而，这种调子，更使他气不打一处来。

en.t: Yet that tone only made him angrier still.

units.source_text: 难道没得到许可，连看报纸的权利都没有了吗？

en.t: Did he not even have the right to read a newspaper without getting permission?

units.source_text: ……男人一阵冲动，他真想大骂一场，

en.t: ... A sudden impulse seized the man; he truly wanted to curse her out,

units.source_text: 甩开女人的手，把盛着水的洗脸盆打翻掉。

en.t: shake off the woman's hand, and overturn the washbasin full of water.
